GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 004 (19 Jun 48) CPC/OD
(SCAPIN-1911/2)
APO 500
25 July 1950
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Purchase and Resale of Agricultural Lands Owned by Persons of Dual Nationality
1. Reference is made to memorandum for Japanese Government, file AG 004 (19 Jun 48) CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1911/1, 4 December 1948, subject as above, from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
2. Paragraph 3 of reference 1 above is hereby amended to permit the Japanese Government to dispose of land in cases where the owner is registered in Japan as a Japanese national and has failed to submit adequate proof that he does not possess Japanese nationality.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K.B. BUSH
Brigadier General, USA
Adjutant General.
